rationale: The replicated Table 8 output at log/tab_ipw_trans.scsv reports coefficients on d_t~eusch_pw (the $1,000 Chinese import exposure regressor) that match the paper's reported values exactly. The 18 output columns pair as 9 log-change (lnchg_*) columns and 9 dollar-change (d_trans_*) columns; mapping the 8 claim-named categories yields, Panel A: total transfers 1.013, TAA 14.406, unemployment 3.460, SSA retirement 0.717, SSA disability 1.960, medical 0.542, fed income assist 3.039, educ/training 2.779; Panel B: total 57.730, TAA 0.234, unemployment 3.421, SSA retirement 9.998, SSA disability 8.395, medical 18.270, fed income assist 7.202, educ/training 3.709. Every one of the 16 cells is within 0.01% of its paper value — a perfect reproduction, including the headline total ($57.73 / 1.013 log points), the largest proportionate TAA effect (14.41 log), and the negligible TAA dollar increase ($0.234) versus the far larger SSA disability ($8.40) and medical ($18.27) dollar effects. fix_severity.json records only a trivial matplotlib install with no impact on numerical results.
